description: /locate finds a Forgotten Library in the Chrono Dawn dimension quickly, and the structure is there when the player looks at it from above.

steps.command: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run locate structure chronodawn:forgotten_library

steps: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers ${x} ${z} 0 1 false ${player}

steps.note: A Forgotten Library around the middle of the image (it is at x=${x}, z=${z}), seen from about 24 blocks north and above. Its blocks render with their textures and nothing is cut off at chunk borders.
